coverageNotes: Tests passing a read-capable context to an ordinary typed helper; no date-formatting or missing-item error design.

questions.question: Which type alias lets this helper and both handlers compile?

options.rationale: A query context lacks mutation-only capabilities required by MutationCtx, so passing it to this helper does not compile.
ActionCtx has no direct db reader, and the query/mutation contexts are not action contexts.
QueryCtx provides the read capabilities used here. MutationCtx can also be passed because it includes those capabilities.
DatabaseReader describes ctx.db, not the full ctx; ctx.db is not a property of DatabaseReader.
